phase: D1-Backed Dimension Acquisition Cost Per Outcome
objective: Load attributed economics views and durable outcome facts once for one explicit canonical relationship cohort, then delegate exact dimension-level acquisition cost per quote and bind projection to INS-004F.

readPlan.attributedViews: at most one getViews call over the canonical cohort
readPlan.outcomeFacts: at most one listForRelationships call over the identical canonical cohort

rules: Relationship IDs are canonically validated and deduplicated at the application boundary while preserving first occurrence order.
The acquisition dimension is validated before downstream reads.
Invalid relationship identity or unsupported dimension fails before downstream reads.
The identical canonical relationship ID array is supplied to attributed economics and durable outcome readers.
A non-empty cohort loads attributed views and durable outcome facts concurrently.
The attributed view application is called at most once.
The durable outcome reader is called at most once.
An empty canonical cohort performs zero downstream reads.

INS-004F remains sole owner of economics/outcome bucket composition, currency isolation, denominator semantics, exact money-per-outcome representation, zero-denominator omission, and bucket consistency checks.
No new SQL, persistence mutation, arithmetic division, percentage formatting, rounding, or currency conversion is introduced.
